decision: Paint the outer yellow as a straight AABB at measured T; Wizards/Neo yellow is 2.33 mm (22/600 on neo3/65), not a greedy scanline walk.
context: Giuseppe: once the border is recognized, the inner join must be a straight line. cohereOuterFrame walked yellow-hue until non-yellow with maxDepth measured+4 and followed gold/holo, producing a 90° step on Gyarados left (T 22→34 around the weakness block) and a jagged top. paintStraightFrame uses mid-side T (cap 7% of short so the ~54 px gold art window cannot win), equalizes left/right, keeps bottom independently (~2.4 mm copyright), and fills that rectangle only. Ground truth: images.pokemontcg.io/neo3/65_hires.png, 21 px left / 22 px top / 23 px bottom on 600×825 = 2.22 / 2.33 / 2.43 mm. Old ~3.2 mm was leftover yellow on a 322 px Base Set studio crop.
alternatives_considered: Keep per-scanline cohereOuterFrame with a smaller maxDepth — still follows gold where isYellowHue is true.
Snap every Wizards card to a fixed 22 px regardless of raster size — wrong on 500 px EX crops.
Retract yellow past T by inventing interior blue — would paint over art.
would_re_examine_if: A Wizards scan is rotated or the printed inner join is not axis-aligned, or a real printed yellow is thicker than 7% of the short side.

decision: Daily CardTrader market import uses one GET /marketplace/products?expansion_id= per set, stores only the cheapest 25 listings per blueprint, and upserts with statement_timeout disabled on the same connection.
context: CardTrader returns far more than 25 listings for popular expansions (23k rows for ~114 cards). Persisting the full book blew the 30s Postgres statement_timeout and would take hours plus false volume. Sold comps are inferred from cheap-25 disappearances and quantity drops (archive reasons inferred_sale / quantity_decreased); listings that fall out of the cheap 25 are dropped_from_cheapest_25, not sales. Our public card_id is ct_id*2 — API calls must use ct_id. Homepage cache is rebuilt once in finalize_cardtrader_daily_market_refresh, not per expansion. Parallel expansion fetches (3) made large JSON downloads contend and were slower; default expansionConcurrency stays 1, opt-in via --expansion-concurrency.
alternatives_considered: Per-blueprint GET (~75k calls, hours)
Store every listing CardTrader returns for an expansion
SET statement_timeout inside the upsert SQL (does not apply to the already-started statement)
Default 3 concurrent expansion fetches
would_re_examine_if: CardTrader adds a cheapest-N query param, or Postgres statement_timeout is raised globally, or expansion JSON payloads become small enough that expansionConcurrency>1 is a net win.

decision: Thickness walks use belongsToPrintedRim (similarToOutline only). pokemontcg transparent corners plus a thin yellow rim are rebuild-frame, not diecut-only. blitRgba skips src alpha so official die-cut holes do not flatten to black nicks inside the padded yellow. isGoldFoilRaster is false when tMed is a printed rim (DP beige and Pikachu art can exceed 40% isYellowHue).

Fill every transparent pixel in the whole card — would paint over intentional PNG holes past the rim.
would_re_examine_if: A true gold-HR raster measures tMed below 6% of the short side after belongsToPrintedRim, or catalog JPEGs need output-T assert before upload.

decision: Sanitize: rotate the inner printed rectangle upright first (vertical yellow→face join, not the name-bar), then measure and rebuild the outer rim to era millimetres. Gold HR / foil-to-edge deskew on the paper silhouette and die-cut only; FA/IR/SIR skip deskew.
context: Giuseppe 2026-09-01: rotate so the inside rectangle is in place, then reconstruct the border with millimetre measures, considering secret-rare/strange art and era. Vertical yellow→face join (Theil–Sen) is the inner rectangle on framed cards; stop when that join is <0.25° even if the top bar is still a few degrees. Gold HR / foil-to-edge has no inner yellow rectangle — align the card silhouette against studio paper, then die-cut only (D00000F). FA/IR/SIR filenames skip deskew because the art is the face. Era millimetres (D00000I) run only after the face is upright. Image y-down: atan(dx/dy) on the side is negated to match Sharp rotate / top-join sign.
alternatives_considered: Deskew from the top name-bar / OLS inner join (Swampert evo-box reads −4.5° and overshoots)
Skip deskew entirely on gold foil (white studio paper then still over-rotated Charizard via the top join)
Rebuild millimetres first, then rotate (AABB paint locks in the tilt)
would_re_examine_if: A secret rare with a real inner gold frame needs the yellow→face join instead of the outer silhouette, or a new era has a non-rectangular inner window.
